Theme

Latin word

ārea

ārea, āreae f.

noun, first declension

an open space: a yard, a building plot, a threshing floor; a building plot; the ground a house stands or is built on; square; yard

In this lexicon

  • area

    avoid · classical · Dig. 50.16.211: locus sine aedificiō in urbe ārea (Lewis & Short); M-O s.v. square, piazza; s.v. yard

  • building site

    also used · classical · Hor. Ep. 1.10.13: pōnendaeque domō quaerenda est ārea prīmum; Cic. Q. fr. 2.5.2: in āream tuam vēnī; Cic. Att. 4.1.7: āream praeclāram habēbimus

  • square

    the recommended word · classical · Traupman 174, 384; M-O s.v. square, piazza

  • yard

    the recommended word · classical · Traupman 409; M-O s.v. yard

    modern

  • ārea statīva: car park

    modern

  • ārea lūsōria; āreae lūsōriae f.: playground

    modern
